title: MetaDecomp: Adaptive Task Decomposition via Meta-Learned Procedural Memory
title_zh: MetaDecomp：通过元学习习得的过程记忆实现自适应任务分解
abstract_en: Reusing past experience in long-horizon tasks requires more than storing successful procedures: Language agents must distinguish which procedures apply and what work remains as execution progresses. We introduce MetaDecomp, an in-context meta-learning framework for adaptive task decomposition that jointly learns a task-relative state space and reusable procedures. Its outer loop builds procedural memory from successful training executions, representing task progress as abstract states and procedures between states as directed acyclic graphs of operations and dependencies. As new progress distinctions are learned, MetaDecomp revisits historical execution evidence to reassess state assignments and reorganize the procedures they support. With memory fixed at test time, the inner loop refines an initial decomposition and revises it from environmental feedback, combining applicable procedure fragments with task-specific steps missing from memory. Evaluated on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld over three seeds, MetaDecomp achieves the highest mean performance among the compared methods in four of five settings, for example, an 86.3% success rate on ALFWorld with Qwen3-4B. Fixing the initial schema or omitting historical reprojection reduces performance in component ablations. MetaDecomp also uses fewer inference tokens than ReAct and AutoRefine in all five settings. Cross-benchmark analysis identifies a low-performance area where partial coverage degrades success relative to hidden memory; high coverage improves success, while low coverage changes little. Code will be released upon acceptance.
abstract_zh: 语言智能体要在长程任务中复用经验，不仅要记住成功流程，还要判断当前哪些流程适用、哪些工作尚未完成。MetaDecomp 是一种上下文元学习框架，联合学习与任务进度相关的抽象状态空间和可复用流程。外循环从成功的训练轨迹中构建过程记忆，将状态间的流程表示为由操作及其依赖关系组成的有向无环图。学到新的进度区分后，框架会回溯历史轨迹，重新判定其状态归属，并重组相应流程。测试时记忆保持固定，内循环根据环境反馈修订初始任务分解，将适用的流程片段与记忆中缺失的任务特定步骤结合起来。在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上，基于三个随机种子的结果显示，MetaDecomp 在五种设置中的四种取得对比方法中最高的平均表现；使用 Qwen3-4B 时，在 ALFWorld 上的成功率为 86.3%。固定初始状态模式或省略历史轨迹重映射都会降低性能。五种设置下，MetaDecomp 的推理 token 用量均低于 ReAct 和 AutoRefine。跨基准分析还发现，相比不向智能体提供过程记忆，低覆盖率影响不大，高覆盖率能提升成功率，而部分覆盖反而可能降低成功率。
key_points_zh: 外循环从成功轨迹中学习抽象进度状态，并用有向无环图表示状态间的操作及其依赖。
学到更细的进度区分后，重新判定历史轨迹的状态归属并重组流程；固定初始状态模式或跳过重映射均会降低性能。
测试时冻结过程记忆，利用环境反馈调整任务分解，复用适用片段并补齐记忆未覆盖的步骤。
在两个基准的五种设置中有四种平均表现领先，且五种设置的推理 token 用量均低于 ReAct 和 AutoRefine。
记忆覆盖率与收益并非单调关系：低覆盖影响不大，部分覆盖可能降低成功率，高覆盖则有益。

agent-memory.reason: 文本代理将成功轨迹整理为由任务进度索引的外部程序记忆；状态模式扩展时重投影旧轨迹并重组程序，测试时冻结记忆但按反馈检索和修订计划。五个模型与基准组合中四个平均表现最佳；单次消融支持历史重投影的作用，迁移分析也指出部分覆盖可能不如隐藏记忆。
